]> 27/07/2026 7:00 Bluebird to start the week.

The bluebird weather continues, with another sunny day on the cards for Monday. We're expecting to see a top of 8 degrees and light north-westerly around 15km/h.

Last night, the temperatures dipped to -4 degrees, giving the snowmaking team an opportunity to fire up the guns. We had 145 guns running across the resort from 8:00pm and still going at time of writing! Conditions on the slopes will be firm and fast underfoot, with hard-packed snow topped with a layer of man-made.

We have 29 lifts scheduled to spin today, and 35 groomed runs for you to enjoy some sunny laps. As always, please keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates, or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop.

Enjoy the sunshine!
